about_the_game:
Introduction

Welcome to Waypoint—a turn-based strategy game for up to four players! Every step is a fight for survival, where you can either reach the finish line to claim victory or eliminate all opponents to be the last one standing.

Waypoint offers a unique approach: there are no good events here. Every occurrence on the map is a challenge designed to make your journey harder. Your only hope? That your opponents have it even worse.

Carve your path to victory, sabotage your rivals, and use the dynamic event system to get ahead. Only intelligence, cunning, and a bit of luck will lead you to triumph!

Game Features

🔥 Relentless Events – Forget about assistance—Waypoint has no friendly events. Tornadoes, fog, destruction—everything works against you. Just make sure your rivals suffer even more!

🏆 Two Ways to Win – Be the first to reach the finish line or eliminate all your opponents to stand alone as the ultimate victor.

🗺️ Dynamic Map – Fight, build roads, and use the terrain to your advantage in this high-stakes race.

🌍 A Living World – Explore detailed tiles, from dense forests to ruins hiding mysterious items that can either aid or hinder you.

👥 Up to 4 Players – Compete with friends, AI bots, or online opponents in a strategic showdown where every move counts.

🔹 Early Access! 🔹

Waypoint is currently in active development! That means you can play right now, shape its future, and be part of its evolution. We are constantly adding new content, improving mechanics, and refining balance based on player feedback.

Coming Soon:
✔️ New mechanics and gameplay improvements
✔️ Additional events and content
✔️ Performance optimization and balance tweaks

Join early access, experience the game first, and help us make Waypoint even better! 🚀
